'''Lune Banjeer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] who served with distinction during the [[Ruusan campaign]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], which lasted from [[1002 BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The Admiral was made the first commander of the Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] at the end of Ruusan campaign, which created the force as a replacement for the disbanded [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. Under Banjeer's leadership, and that of his successors, the Judicial Forces fought successfully in a series of [[Unification Campaigns]] in the period between 1000 BBY and [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lune Banjeer was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]]. Two other individuals, [[Llon Banjeer]] and [[Boss Banjeer]], share the admiral's surname, but no connection has been established between them.
